review.identity: Blind passes independent of the lead: 2026-10-04 Codex gpt-5.6-terra + Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Opus 5.5 reconciled); 2026-10-06 blind pass; 2026-10-18 two blind Claude Sonnet 5.5 raters (batches 1+2); 2026-10-24 two blind Claude Sonnet 5.5 raters for #1128-#1136 (stricter severity on disagreement). Assembled by the Fable 5.1 lead without re-rating.

ratings.rationale: [low] Claude: Feature request (tiled rendering for memory); no wrong output. | Terra: Tiled rendering is an unimplemented memory/performance feature, not a current silent image defect. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Feature request / perf-only (persistent data between animation frames). | Terra: Persistent animation data is an optimization request rather than an image-correctness defect. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Unimplemented feature (diffraction grating BSDF); not silent, no Blender-native setting involved. | Terra: Diffraction grating support is an unscheduled new material feature. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Unimplemented Pillar-4 feature (nebula media presets); Pillar 4 paused. | Terra: Nebula-specific media are a paused, unimplemented feature; existing emission/spectral volume work landed separately. | Reconciliation: agree
[low] Claude: Long-horizon architecture tracker, no code. | Terra: This is a long-horizon architecture tracker for standalone/Hydra support. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Variance-only gap vs Cycles at equal spp on corpus scenes; geometry/colour match, mean unchanged. Partly addressed by #1003 stratified sampling but still open. | Terra: The report identifies substantially higher equal-spp noise while geometry and mean appearance match; it is variance-only. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Limb 0.84x Cycles with clamp_indirect=10; 2026-09-29 comment shows export is faithful and the residual is a diffuse-glass-lamp caustic energy gap (Cycles-specific speckle), a bounded accuracy gap rather than a wrong image. | Terra: Astroray remains about 0.84x Cycles for the glass limb under the native clamp setting, a visible caustic-energy loss. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: addon export faithful (2026-09-29 comment); residual is Cycles-only diffuse->glass->lamp speckle caustic.

[low] Claude: Thin-film rough glass falls back to single-scatter (correct, unbiased per issue); quality improvement only. | Terra: Thin-film rough glass intentionally uses the correct unbiased single-scatter fallback; thin-film-aware multiscatter is an enhancement. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Rough-glass multiple-scatter walk is achromatic (no dispersion); pre-existing, not a regression, enhancement. | Terra: Rough-glass dispersion is documented as unmodelled, producing a bounded spectral-accuracy gap rather than a crash or dropped setting. | Reconciliation: kept higher (medium)
[low] Claude: Owner try-out checklist, not a defect. | Terra: The issue is an owner evaluation checklist, not a renderer defect. | Reconciliation: kept higher (low)
[low] Claude: Test-infra path resolution bug in pkg258 byte-identity test. | Terra: This is test harness module-path resolution, with no renderer behavior change. | Reconciliation: agree
[low] Claude: Delegate tooling investigation. | Terra: Delegate critic completion is tooling reliability work. | Reconciliation: agree
[low] Claude: Build-tool reliability (sccache vs long CUDA compile), no renderer effect. | Terra: CUDA cache-launcher reliability is build tooling only. | Reconciliation: agree

[not-applicable] Claude: In-place mesh object move (triangle-range delta transform + BVH refit + GPU patch) landed in 82b24fc6 (#1049). | Terra: Commit 82b24fc6 (#1049) adds triangle-range transform updates, BVH refit, and cached GPU patching for mesh moves. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: GPU 64^3 nearest-voxel bake loses fine detail on coordinate-warped procedurals; region means agree (0.25%). Noise/Wave/Voronoi are now per-hit on GPU (a97e97ee #1023), the warped-checker bake remains (see #1002). | Terra: The 64³ GPU procedural bake remains visibly lossy, but current #1009 behavior reports the approximation as DEGRADED rather than silently flattening it. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Kerr spin drives geodesics/redshift but disk flux and ISCO stay a=0 (include/astroray/black_hole.h:100-102,370-371); documented interim in code, Pillar 4 paused, but the spin panel gives no warning so arguably silent. | Terra: A Kerr disk with nonzero spin still uses the Schwarzschild model, yielding a wrong reachable GR image. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: Pillar 4 (paused) documented interim (black_hole.h:100-102); not a Blender-native setting.
[low] Claude: Reference-bank re-bless/test baseline work; no user-visible defect. | Terra: Reference re-blessing and metric attribution are test/evidence maintenance. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Dead code today (runSMSAttemptDevice has no callers), nothing renders wrong. | Terra: The divergent SMS device routine has no callers, so it cannot affect a current render. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: kMaxLampPassthrough=4 drops the 5th+ lamp on one ray segment (energy loss, not flagged); needs 5+ lamps along a single segment so narrow reach. | Terra: The fifth and later lamp on a ray segment is silently dropped by the fixed cap of four, losing reachable scene energy. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: 5th+ lamp on one segment (kMaxLampPassthrough=4); rare, small energy loss.

[medium] Claude: CPU uses mt19937 (no QMC): variance x spp stays flat vs Cycles falling 4.5x; means unchanged, variance-only. #1003 added Sobol-Burley camera group but not full QMC. | Terra: The CPU mt19937 sampler has worse convergence than Cycles QMC while preserving the mean; this is variance behavior. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Disney half-metal 0.91-0.93x Cycles; Disney is the non-default path (native Principled default ON), bounded accuracy gap. | Terra: A normal half-metal Principled material renders 0.91–0.93x Cycles because the closure mixture is physically different. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: Disney custom material only (Blender export uses native Principled); <10%.

[medium] Claude: 80f39ec5 (#1030) routes multi-input scalar programs to graph value programs on CPU+GPU (stage_graph_eval.cu), removing the single-texture GPU limit. | Terra: GPU multi-texture scalar programs degrade to a constant, but the addon explicitly reports this DEGRADED behavior. | Reconciliation: Claude fixed (80f39ec5) / Terra medium; kept medium until the issue is verified and closed.

[medium] Claude: Disney metallic>0 + transmission CPU/GPU 2.2-4.0x; only reachable with use_native_principled off (default on), so non-default path. | Terra: Constant Disney metallic-plus-transmission material remains GPU/CPU divergent by 2–4x; the current tests retain it as #956. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: Disney custom material only (use_native_principled off), strict xfails.

[medium] Claude: Principled rough glass GPU/CPU 1.03-1.07 (single-scatter vs Heitz walk); small bounded gap, pre-existing. | Terra: Reachable Principled rough glass has a persistent 3–7% GPU/CPU image discrepancy. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: GPU rough glass 1.03-1.07x CPU, strict xfails, bounded.

[medium] Claude: Marginal single-channel outliers 0.03-0.04 outside MC band, possibly noise-underestimated bands; luminance within 1.02-1.05. | Terra: The thin-film channel deviations are marginal, documented strict-xfail accuracy gaps requiring higher-spp confirmation. | Reconciliation: kept higher (medium)

[medium] Claude: ReSTIR-DI uses texture mean for textured emitters with a printed DEGRADED line; flagged degradation, non-default integrator. | Terra: GPU ReSTIR textured emission uses a texture mean, but emits a DEGRADED report. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: GPU instanced textured emitters keep texture mean with a DEGRADED report; flagged. | Terra: GPU instanced textured emitters use a documented texture-mean degradation rather than silently claiming exact support. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Red channel 0.955 of Cycles at volume_bounces 4; bounded colour bias, pre-existing. | Terra: The native volume-bounces path is measurably red-deficient at 0.955x Cycles without a user-visible warning. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: 4.5% single-channel media bias, bounded.

[low] Claude: CPU not bit-stable across refactors (<=2.1e-7 FMA contraction); test-gate fragility only. | Terra: This is floating-point reproducibility/test-gate robustness, with differences bounded to 2.1e-7. | Reconciliation: agree
[low] Claude: test_results conventions and docs follow-ups. | Terra: These are result-layout, documentation, and evidence-maintenance tasks. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Single deterministic firefly at one seed on the MSVC CPU leg; MinGW reads 1.000, not a mean bias; provisional test row. | Terra: The 1.33x smoke ROI is a deterministic single-seed firefly; cross-build evidence indicates a variance tail rather than mean bias. | Reconciliation: kept higher (medium)

[low] Claude: Test-band sigma underestimated from correlated seeds; test calibration only. | Terra: Correlated-seed sigma underestimation is corpus tolerance tooling, not renderer output behavior. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: op-VM per-hit inputs (Layer Weight/Fresnel/Geometry) landed in 150fad17 (#1009); shader_vm_compiler.py handles LAYER_WEIGHT/NEW_GEOMETRY (lines 451-456, 640-646). | Terra: #1009 fixes Layer Weight, Fresnel, and Backfacing; remaining Geometry Pointiness behavior is explicitly reported rather than silently flattened. | Reconciliation: Claude fixed (150fad17) / Terra medium; Pointiness residual reported; kept medium.

[medium] Claude: Nested Mix Shader with textured Fac applies the texture only to scalar params; reported as 'approximated MIX_SHADER' so flagged, closure composition still missing. | Terra: Nested textured Mix/Add/Glass trees still collapse to a constant opaque Principled result at 0.28–0.45x Cycles. | Reconciliation: kept medium as 2026-10-03: collapse is reported (approximated MIX_SHADER warning), so flagged.

[low] Claude: Flaky test_spatial_reduces_mse (effect below frame noise); test design only. | Terra: This is a statistically flaky ReSTIR validation test rather than a demonstrated rendering defect. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Test gate at the noise edge; XPASSed 3/3 after #1055 (b282a2c6), strict=False. | Terra: The possible 9% sun-photon bias is bounded by a noisy reference and remains inconclusive after #1055 XPASS observations. | Reconciliation: kept higher (medium)

[low] Claude: pkg299 perf/architecture follow-ups (TTFS, IAS refit, shared context). | Terra: TTFS, refit, context sharing, and transparent-shadow OptiX routing are performance/architecture follow-ups. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: GPU warped-checker bake mis-samples ~61% vs model 48.6% once CPU noise floor is gone; bounded GPU procedural accuracy gap, strict-xfail test. | Terra: The persistent GPU bake discrepancy is visible but currently measured and carried as a strict-xfail degradation, not a silent flat-value drop. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Tiling fixed in ff7e1438 (#1011, REPEAT extension); residual centre ~0.91x suspected bump/normal step order, bounded. | Terra: Commit ff7e1438 (#1011) fixes REPEAT tiling and Mapping for Normal/Bump images; the noted residual is a separate bump-footprint accuracy issue. | Reconciliation: Terra fixed / Claude medium: residual centre ~0.91x after #1011; kept medium.

[medium] Claude: Procedural Bump Height is now a DegradationReport entry (#1011); overshoot vs Cycles remains but flagged. | Terra: Procedural Bump Height is no longer silent after #1011; it is explicitly reported DEGRADED pending CPU/GPU footprint support. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Segment light-pick fix in 305bf1a4 (#1054) restores 1/N convergence on v2_media (#1032 text); remaining distance-strategy variance is tracked as #1032. | Terra: #1054 removed the prior non-1/N tail mechanism, but remaining smoke variance is documented and bounded as a variance problem. | Reconciliation: Terra medium / Claude fixed: #1054 removed the tail mechanism; residual variance tracked (#1032); kept open as medium.

[medium] Claude: Out-of-gamut negative channels clipped to 0 per pass/beauty (sodium lamp B=0 vs Mitsuba -0.096); small bias and passes sum-to-beauty only when no negatives; owner decision pending. | Terra: This is an explicit scene-linear film-output policy decision about negative channels and downstream formats. | Reconciliation: kept higher (medium)

[medium] Claude: GPU lambertian skips a texture-less op-VM program, strict-xfail in test_pkg314; Blender export routes Diffuse BSDF to principled (blender_addon/__init__.py:5356-5380), so not reachable from node export. | Terra: GPU Lambertian base color silently skips texture-less per-hit op-VM programs and renders their constant value. | Reconciliation: Terra high; medium: Blender export routes Diffuse BSDF to principled (blender_addon/__init__.py:5355-5376), so the GPU lambertian op-VM skip is Python-API-only and strict-xfailed.

[medium] Claude: Heterogeneous segment NEE uses the hull global majorant: smoke VDB per-sample variance ~75x Cycles; variance-only, means in band. | Terra: The global-majorant strategy has severe but mean-bounded heterogeneous-media variance; the stated gate requires mean parity. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: Object/Generated coords slide under motion blur; reported by the addon as an APPROXIMATED degradation (blender_addon/__init__.py:6860-6866). | Terra: Object/Generated coordinates slide under motion blur, but the addon currently reports Object-coordinate motion blur as APPROXIMATED. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Adaptive sampling saves less than ideal (ratio 0.78-0.84 vs ~0.09); efficiency only, gate (d) passes provisional bound. | Terra: Adaptive allocation is functional but inefficient relative to the reference ideal; this is quality/performance tuning. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Coverage-matrix generator tooling gap (output sockets, Mix Shader branch). | Terra: The matrix scanner falsely reports already-handled output paths as silent; this is audit tooling, not an image defect. | Reconciliation: agree

[medium] Claude: CPU photon caustics use one 3M map per render so gather speckle does not average out; ROI means agree with GPU/oracle (0.998-1.002), variance-only. | Terra: CPU photon-map speckle is frozen across spp while means match the GPU/oracle; this is an estimator-variance issue. | Reconciliation: agree

[low] Claude: Reference-bank phash gate sits at MC noise floor; test metric issue. | Terra: The pHash threshold is a noise-sensitive test metric; other image metrics pass with margin. | Reconciliation: agree

Cornell half was a harness setup mismatch plus an SSIM reader change, fixed on main by a52f0e07 (#1074, SSIM 0.9994); the world_sky_hdri half is noise-limited SSIM at 128 spp, no engine defect shown. Close candidate once the hdri row is reclassified.

Diffuse surfaces inside r_max render dark and lamps are blocked by the influence sphere; wrong image but Pillar 4 (paused), not a Blender-native setting, and a known limitation of #1063 (emissive spheres render correctly). Same class as #894.
Second-order correction (inverse shift on incident light) deliberately not half-applied; depends on #1081 first. Pillar 4, paused.
Scoring tooling and frozen-predicate design for gate (b); no user-visible rendering defect (checker itself matches Cycles). Gate (b) is separate from gate (e).
Scanner/collector bookkeeping: working features read as drops. Tooling only, affects b4 scoring not renders.
Scanner bookkeeping; render unaffected. Lane item 4.
Native setting silently ignored but only after a ReSTIR render or above 31; same class as #1073/#1115. Lane item 9.
Custom Disney material; never reached by the Blender export.

[medium] A: Hair Random, Random Roughness and Random Color have no effect on the render. The addon now reports this drop, and the sockets are a narrow, rarely used per-strand feature. | B: Hair Random/Random Roughness/Random Color are ignored but now reported when changed; this is a narrow-reach per-strand randomisation feature on hair only, so degraded but flagged. | Reconciliation: agree

ratings.rationale: [medium] A: A Normal or Bump input on most standalone BSDF nodes is ignored, a visible deviation. It is now reported, and the Principled BSDF still honours its Normal input. | B: Normal/Bump on standalone BSDFs is ignored and now reported; reach is broad across many nodes, but it is flagged, so it stays medium rather than high. | Reconciliation: agree
ratings.source: 2026-10-24 two blind Sonnet 5.5 raters (A/B), stricter wins

ratings.rationale: [medium] A: Linked Tangent inputs and the Principled Coat Normal have no effect and are rendered with the default tangent and normal. This is reported, and it affects only a narrow set of anisotropic or coat setups. | B: Linked Tangent and Coat Normal are ignored but reported when connected; it affects only anisotropic or coat inputs, which is narrow reach, and it is flagged. | Reconciliation: agree
ratings.source: 2026-10-24 two blind Sonnet 5.5 raters (A/B), stricter wins

ratings.rationale: [medium] A: The Anisotropic BSDF renders as an isotropic Glossy because Anisotropy and Rotation are never read. This is reported, but the node's whole purpose is lost, so it is a clear visible degradation. | B: The Anisotropic node renders as isotropic Glossy, which is a wrong look, but the drop is now reported when Anisotropy or Rotation is changed. Borderline high, since the whole node is effectively broken, but flagged means medium. | Reconciliation: agree
ratings.source: 2026-10-24 two blind Sonnet 5.5 raters (A/B), stricter wins

ratings.rationale: [medium] A: The distribution enum (GGX, Multiscatter GGX, Beckmann, Sheen model) is not honoured on six node types. This is a subtle but real look difference, and it is now reported. | B: The distribution enum has little visible effect (GGX vs Multiscatter or Beckmann, Sheen variants) and is now reported. Borderline medium, but the subtle difference and the report put it at low. | Reconciliation: A medium / B low -> stricter

ratings.rationale: [medium] A: The Subsurface method and Subsurface IOR are ignored, and a single approximate diffusion model is used. The deviation is visible only in subsurface scenes, and the addon now names both inputs in its report. | B: Subsurface method and IOR are ignored and now named in the warning; the native model is a single approximation, so there is visible deviation but it is flagged and narrow. | Reconciliation: agree

The Density and Temperature attributes work, so the case is very narrow, and the drop is now reported. | B: Volume Color Attribute from a VDB vec3 grid is a rare input, and it is now reported; the density and temperature attributes still work, so reach is very narrow. | Reconciliation: agree

It only matters for legacy Preetham/Hosek types and is now reported, so there is minimal visible effect. | Reconciliation: agree
